content.caption: A tall grey stone block stands in the foreground on bright green grass, with a few wooden frames and dark signboards behind it and a red-roofed building further off. Pine and broadleaf trees line the island under a pale sky, and a grey rock mound sits to the left.
content.opinion: The bookshelf is in the picture, but only just, and the stone block is clearly the more important thing, so I have kept both on record anyway.
